October 2, 2026

Pentagon expands nuclear options as US reinforces Middle East

tags: war, defence, politics
sources: @hunteralexanderhowell, @oafnation_actual

The United States is sending a third aircraft carrier, roughly 10,000 additional troops and ground vehicles to the Middle East, and the Pentagon is reportedly broadening the nuclear options available to President Trump, according to remarks attributed to Under Secretary of Defense Elbridge Colby. Iranian commanders are said to be preparing a wider response should the US launch another major attack, with Reuters reporting that potential targets could extend beyond the region. Aligned groups in Lebanon, Yemen and Iraq have reportedly been told to prepare. No final decision on an attack has been made.

Rubio ordered Iranian delegation out of New York as talks stalled

tags: politics, war
sources: @oafnation_actual

US officials say Secretary of State Marco Rubio ordered Iran's foreign minister and his delegation to leave New York after indirect talks reached an impasse. Iran disputes that account, saying its departure had already been scheduled. The delegation left early Tuesday with US-Iran diplomacy deadlocked.

Kushner fund held major stake in Israeli firm while he negotiated in Gaza

tags: politics, war, legal
sources: @ericmoutsos, @hunteralexanderhowell

A CNN investigation found that Affinity Partners, the private equity firm owned by Jared Kushner, held the largest stake in Phoenix Financial, a Tel Aviv-based firm backing businesses involved in Israel's military campaigns, while Kushner acted as a key negotiator in the war in Gaza. Kushner's group doubled its stake in Phoenix last year, shortly before Trump returned to office, and he later described it as Affinity's best investment. Because he serves as a volunteer envoy rather than holding a confirmed government post, he is not required to disclose his finances. Critics describe the arrangement as an unprecedented dual role blending private business with high-stakes wartime diplomacy.

Trump consulted Grok chatbot before weighing Venezuela invasion

tags: politics, tech, defence
sources: @aaronparnas, @hunteralexanderhowell

Time magazine reported that President Trump has repeatedly relied on AI chatbots when considering major decisions, including whether to capture Nicolas Maduro and invade Venezuela. During a December 2025 meeting at the White House with Elon Musk, Trump spent hours questioning Grok about his presidency and legacy, and asked how Venezuelans would react to a US operation to capture Maduro. After seeing celebrations in the streets, he reportedly described the chatbot's answer as ingenious. The reporting has prompted calls for guardrails on the use of AI in national security decisions.

September jobs report comes in far below expectations

tags: markets, economy, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

The US economy added just 29,000 jobs in September, well short of the 89,000 economists had forecast. The unemployment rate rose to 4.2 percent against expectations of 4.1 percent, and August's figure was revised down by 29,000. It is the third weakest monthly jobs print of 2026, arriving weeks before the November midterm elections.

Trump administration sends $500 health rebate checks to battleground states

tags: politics, health, economy
sources: @aaronparnas, @hunteralexanderhowell

The administration is sending $500 Obamacare rebate checks to nearly 950,000 Americans, with 71 percent of the payments going to battleground states, according to Reuters. Officials describe the payments as a refund of excessive user fees, and recipients are also receiving a letter from President Trump blaming Joe Biden for inflating insurance premiums. Analysts have characterised the timing as legal bribery and said the payments could swing close races. The checks come as the president's approval rating sits at its lowest point and Democratic early-vote turnout is rising.

Letitia James appointed special prosecutor in Cornell 7 case

tags: legal, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed an executive order appointing Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor in the Cornell 7 case. Hochul said newly released information raises serious questions about the investigation conducted by the Cornell Police Department and about the decision of the Tompkins County District Attorney. James is authorised to investigate and prosecute any offenses related to the case, superseding the district attorney who declined to bring charges.

Nuclear-powered data center plan seeks 9,000 acres of Utah public land

tags: climate, tech, politics
sources: @carolinegleich

Valar Atomics, a startup that has built one small test reactor, is seeking 9,000 acres of public land near Price, Utah, for 456 reactors plus a fuel plant and nuclear waste storage to power private data centers not connected to the grid. The state has already approved 640 acres for up to 100 years, and the chair of the approving board acknowledged members were not always sure what to ask; federal review of the remainder is under way. In litigation against federal regulators the company claimed spent fuel could be held in the hand for a dose comparable to a CT scan, a figure a nuclear engineer at another small-reactor firm calculated would instead be fatal in about 90 seconds. An internal Energy Department memo noted how much money looser radiation exposure limits would save the company on shielding, and the Salt Lake Tribune reported DOGE staff joked that Utah had "been downwind before." Critics note the state is among the driest in the country, that reactor cooling requires water, that the US has no permanent waste repository, and that a previous Utah small-nuclear effort was cancelled in 2023 after costs passed $9 billion.

Family of woman killed in ICE operation sues US government

tags: immigration, legal, politics
sources: @groundnews

The family of Renee Good has sued the US government, ICE officer Jonathan Ross and officials involved in the administration's immigration crackdown over her killing in Minneapolis in January. The suits allege wrongful death, excessive force and civil rights violations, and seek unspecified damages. Ross shot Good as she drove her SUV away during an immigration operation; federal officials said he acted in self-defense, while the family argues the shooting flowed from the enforcement campaign. At a September 22 congressional forum, Good's mother Donna Ganger said she voted for Trump believing federal agents would protect Americans from terrorists.

Justice Department reviews misconduct allegations against Watergate prosecutors

tags: legal, politics
sources: @groundnews

The Justice Department is reviewing allegations that Watergate prosecutors committed misconduct during the investigation that led to President Richard Nixon's resignation, the Wall Street Journal reported. Former Nixon aide Geoff Shepard gave a two-hour presentation to the department's Office of Professional Responsibility, alleging that special prosecutors Archibald Cox and Leon Jaworski secretly met with judges and withheld evidence from defendants. A department spokesperson said the presentation does not constitute an investigation.

Anthropic briefed religious leaders on AI consciousness under NDAs

tags: tech, media
sources: @aaronparnas

New York Times reporting says Anthropic invited religious scholars and leaders to San Francisco to advise on AI safety, asked them to sign non-disclosure agreements, and sought to persuade them that its Claude model is conscious and deserves moral standing. The report also says company leaders approached the Vatican about altering the text of a document so that it would not deny AI personhood.

Michigan removes Larry Nassar and 20,000 others from sex offender registry

tags: legal, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Former USA Gymnastics doctor Larry Nassar has been removed from Michigan's sex offender registry, one of roughly 20,000 people taken off in a 24-hour period. The removals follow a September 9 Michigan Supreme Court ruling that amendments to the state's Sex Offender Registration Act cannot be applied retroactively, exempting people whose offenses predate 2011. Nassar remains in prison serving decades-long sentences and would have to re-register if ever released. Victims and prosecutors have reacted with anger to the decision.

Federal judge blocks Connecticut semiautomatic pistol restriction

tags: legal, politics
sources: @oafnation_actual

A federal judge blocked Connecticut's new restriction on certain semiautomatic pistols hours before it was due to take effect. The judge found the challengers are likely to succeed on their Second Amendment claim. The preliminary injunction remains in place while the underlying lawsuits proceed.

Trump offers dinner access to buyers of his meme coin

tags: politics, markets
sources: @aaronparnas

First reported by Jeff Stein, an invitation circulated for a dinner tied to President Trump's meme coin, billed as the most exclusive dinner in the world. Buyers of $1 million worth of the coin join a "Trump coin club" that includes VIP seating at the dinner and reception, a Trump gold watch, and access to other guests. The invitation features an image of Trump presented as slimmer and younger.

Trump presses Senate to pass permanent daylight saving time

tags: politics, government
sources: @aaronparnas

President Trump is pressuring the Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act, which would make daylight saving time permanent and end seasonal clock changes. The bill passed the House of Representatives earlier this year by 308 to 117 and now awaits Senate action. Trump has publicly criticised Republican Senator Tom Cotton over the measure and is demanding a vote as soon as possible.

Colorado Republican governor candidate recounts assaulting his wife

tags: politics, elections
sources: @aaronparnas

Victor Marx, a Republican running statewide for governor of Colorado, described on camera how he grabbed his wife and slammed her into the front door of their home after she said she no longer needed martial arts training. In the account he says the push left her bent over and crying. He recounted the incident with laughter while describing his background as a black belt and Marine.

Trump links FlyDubai hijacking co-pilot to Iran as Netanyahu cites radicalisation

tags: politics, defence, war
sources: @total.hypocrisy

President Trump said on October 1 that he is hearing the co-pilot involved in the FlyDubai hijacking is linked to Iran, two days after initially speculating about the pilot's motives. The BBC reported Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu saying the attacker had undergone Islamist radical indoctrination. A passenger described as a hero of the incident met Netanyahu and asked him to pass a message of affection to Trump. The claims come in the same week Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed the US military will cut 20 percent of its generals and admirals.

California bans child marriage

tags: politics, legal
sources: @groundnews

Governor Gavin Newsom signed a law requiring people to be at least 18 to marry in California, effective January 1, 2027, making it the 18th state to prohibit child marriage since 2018. The state previously had no minimum marriage age where parents consented and a judge approved. The advocacy group Unchained At Last estimates about 9,000 girls married each year in California, with most marriages involving girls and adult men. The practice remains legal in 32 states.

Massachusetts probe finds 270 priests abused nearly 1,000 children

tags: legal, politics
sources: @groundnews

A report from Massachusetts Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell found that more than 270 Catholic clerics sexually abused nearly 1,000 children over decades in the Fall River, Springfield and Worcester dioceses. Campbell said church officials often protected the institution rather than children. The investigation produced three referrals to local prosecutors and charges in one Worcester case; other conduct was not illegal at the time or fell outside statutes of limitations. Campbell called for reforms including eliminating time limits on civil childhood sexual-abuse claims.

Former deputy acquitted in shooting death of Airman Roger Fortson

tags: legal, politics
sources: @oafnation_actual

Former Okaloosa County sheriff's deputy Eddie Duran was found not guilty of manslaughter in the 2024 shooting death of Air Force Senior Airman Roger Fortson. Jurors deliberated for a little more than two hours before returning the verdict.

MLB drops plan for a game at Grand Teton National Park

tags: climate, politics
sources: @carolinegleich

Major League Baseball has withdrawn a proposal to host a game at Grand Teton National Park. The plan drew opposition after the Washington Post reported on it, with local leaders sending letters to the Trump administration and the MLB commissioner. The announcement came on October 1.

Judge denies acquittal motion in Lindsay Clancy case

tags: legal
sources: @aaronparnas

Judge William Sullivan denied a motion to find Lindsay Clancy not guilty following her mistrial. Defense lawyer Kevin Ruddington had argued the evidence was insufficient both to prove she killed her children and to establish criminal responsibility at the time. Prosecutors are expected to retry the case, with a trial date to be set on November 2.

Trump seeks federal landmark status for the Oval Office

tags: politics, government
sources: @aaronparnas

In an interview with Time magazine, President Trump said he is urging White House chief of staff Susie Wiles to have the Oval Office declared a federal landmark so the gold fixtures he installed on the fireplace, mantle and throughout the room cannot be removed. The push follows his demolition of the East Wing. Legal experts note the president lacks the authority to designate the room himself.

Marine Corps lowers time-in-service requirement for sergeant

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

Marines are now eligible for promotion to sergeant after 30 months of service instead of 48, with the change applying across the Total Force. It reverses an earlier policy that raised the minimum from 24 to 48 months. Promotion is not automatic at 30 months and all other eligibility requirements remain in place.

Soldiers went a week without running water over unfiled work order

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

Soldiers at an Army installation went a week without running water before a leader discovered that no one had submitted a work order. The leader said the problem was resolved the same day once it was reported.

Marine veteran sentenced to 11 years in death of infant son

tags: legal
sources: @oafnation_actual

Milton Paniagua, a Marine Corps veteran who represented himself in court while wearing a military uniform, was sentenced to 11 years in prison over the death of his eight-month-old son. Jurors deadlocked on murder and assault charges, prompting a mistrial. He then accepted a plea to voluntary manslaughter.

Three former Hill Air Force Base daycare workers charged with assault

tags: legal
sources: @oafnation_actual

Three former daycare workers at Hill Air Force Base face federal assault charges involving toddlers and young children. Prosecutors allege children were pushed, roughly handled and pinned down, including one child whose face was repeatedly covered with a pillow. All three defendants are presumed innocent.

Navy chief arrested in undercover child-sex sting at Fort Gordon

tags: legal
sources: @oafnation_actual

Norman Laureano Miranda, 37, a Navy chief stationed at Fort Gordon, was arrested in an undercover child-sex investigation. Police allege he sent sexually explicit messages to an operative he believed was a child and attempted to arrange a meeting. NCIS assisted in the arrest and he is presumed innocent.

Substack series launched on Netanyahu's influence in US culture

tags: media, politics
sources: @total.hypocrisy

An independent journalist announced the first installment of a ten-part series examining Benjamin Netanyahu's long-standing influence in American politics, culture and entertainment. The opening piece covers his childhood and early professional years. The work is published free with an optional paid subscription.
